sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "School"."County" AS g, AVG((CAST("budget"."Budget_invested_percent" AS REAL) / "budget"."total_budget_percent_invested")) AS m1 FROM "budget" JOIN "School" ON "School"."School_id" = "budget"."School_id" GROUP BY "School"."County"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: budget.invested as percent of budgeted relative to invested share of total budget
why: invested as percent of budgeted / invested share of total budget: a ratio of two quantities in percent
average of invested as percent of budgeted relative to invested share of total budget per School.County
index against the all average of average of invested as percent of budgeted relative to invested share of total budget (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "School"."County" AS g, AVG("budget"."total_budget_percent_invested") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("budget"."Budget_invested_percent" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted") AS REAL) / "budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted")) AS m2 FROM "budget" JOIN "School" ON "School"."School_id" = "budget"."School_id" GROUP BY "School"."County"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: budget.relative difference of invested as percent of budgeted from budgeted share of total budget
why: average of invested share of total budget per School.County
(invested as percent of budgeted - budgeted share of total budget) / budgeted share of total budget: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of invested as percent of budgeted from budgeted share of total budget per School.County
index against the all average of average of invested share of total budget (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "School"."County" AS g, AVG(("budget"."Budgeted" - "budget"."Invested")) AS m1 FROM "budget" JOIN "School" ON "School"."School_id" = "budget"."School_id" GROUP BY "School"."County"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"
why: amount budgeted - amount invested: both in USD and of the same kind (flows) on the same one school's budget in one year
average of amount budgeted minus amount invested per School.County
gap to the all average of average of amount budgeted minus amount invested (all level)
